Nadia (CSM): Heads-up — OrchardPay token volume fell ~71% since yesterday and their ML lead dropped a note saying they're "validating AltServe" today. Need fast renewal-risk triage. :eyes:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: OrchardPay (acct_7432) - 71% WoW. AlertID: UDF-7432-19
Ethan (AE): Oof. Who's our internal champion? have they signaled procurement or cost pressure?
Nadia (CSM): Champion is Marco (ML). He flagged jitter after our last model pin and said their SRE queued a short evaluation with AltServe starting today. No formal RFP yet.
Ravi (SE): Quick telemetry (requests/day):```
2026-11-20: 39,200
2026-11-21: 37,800
2026-11-22: 12,400
2026-11-23: 8,900
2026-11-24: 6,500
2026-11-25: 4,900
```
Sima (CS Ops): Proposed play: 1) 20m check-in within 24h; 2) offer a 72h env-parity bench where we host our variant to rule out infra mismatch; 3) deliver regression on their golden prompts + short SLO/cost note. I'll try to book.
Ethan (AE): Commercial: propose a small env-parity credit and ask for the competitor pilot scope + success metrics on the call. Can someone pull the last 60d prompt evals?
Ravi (SE): I'll prepare a minimal repro and a one-pager highlighting gains from enabling prefix/KV cache + pinned q4_8bit variant. Quick config we can flip during bench:```
PATCH /v1/accounts/7432/config
{ "prefix_cache": true, "quant_variant": "q4_8bit" }
```
Nadia (CSM): Action items: Ethan - lead outreach and extract competitor success criteria; Ravi - repro + one-pager before call; Sima - book 20m and attach telemetry + regression; Nadia - prep renewal-risk note and flag exec-escalation if they indicate replacement.
Sima (CS Ops): Booked 20m with Marco for 2026-11-26 10:30 PT. Agenda: usage trend, competitor scope, demo of cache/quant wins, env-parity offer. Invite includes telemetry + repro link.
Ethan (AE): On the call I'll ask for a 72h controlled A/B (we host our variant) and request written success metrics. If they refuse, push for same-hardware comparison or at least shared input prompts.
Ravi (SE): Prep note: enabling prefix cache + pinned quant typically cuts p50 latency on retrieval flows from ~160ms -> ~85ms in our internal tests. I'll drop the one-pager to the invite now.
redwood-bot: [note] alert acknowledged by Nadia at 2026-11-25T15:04:12Z
Nadia (CSM): If competitor pilot confirms parity testing, escalate to Director CS for a QBR within 7 business days. Case# CS-7432-ENV_CHECK. Keep thread replies short for handoff.
Ethan (AE): 👍 will update after the 11/26 call.
